title: newLoopState
responsibility: Builds inherited loop state while adding a versioned completion contract only when a task kind is explicitly requested.

inputs.name: newLoopState.root
inputs.description: Project root that newLoopState passes to resolveLoopTemplate only when input.from is set; resolveLoopTemplate then reads project templates from specification/loop-templates under it, and newLoopState itself does not check the value.

inputs.name: newLoopState.input
inputs.type: { name: string; goal: string; createdAt: string; from?: string; kind?: 'coding' | 'planning'; plan?: string; }
inputs.description: name, goal and createdAt are stored unchanged (createdAt also becomes updatedAt) and are not validated here. from names a template to inherit, and kind (which must be 'coding' or 'planning') adds completion; plan is stored in completion.plan only when kind is set, and the completion audit later reads it as a committed project-relative path.

examples.name: fix-checkout-totals
examples.goal: Correct the tax rounding in the checkout summary.

examples.name: csv-export-plan
examples.goal: Plan a CSV export for the orders report.

examples.name: fix-login-redirect
examples.goal: Stop the login page from redirecting back to itself after sign-in.

outputs.name: newLoopState
outputs.description: The returned state carries name, goal, createdAt and updatedAt (set to createdAt), steps copied from the resolved template with status pending (an empty list without from), and template, templateLineage and evaluators from that template (undefined without from). completion appears only when kind is set, and enforceOrder is true with regressionCommits 1 when the template lineage contains bug-fix or regression-prevention.

examples.name: fix-login-redirect
examples.goal: Stop the login page from redirecting back to itself after sign-in.

examples.name: csv-export-plan
examples.goal: Plan a CSV export for the orders report.

examples.name: nightly-cleanup
examples.goal: Remove stale report caches older than seven days.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail() when input.kind is not 'coding' or 'planning'; resolveLoopTemplate also throws it for an invalid or unknown template id, an inheritance cycle, or an empty required template field.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejected when a project template file under specification/loop-templates is not valid JSON, because readProjectTemplates rethrows every error except ENOENT.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejected when a project template field has the wrong type, such as a non-array steps or evaluators value or a non-string id, because normalizeSteps, normalizeEvaluators, validateLoopId and validateRequiredText call array or string methods on it without a type check.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejected with a Node file-system error other than ENOENT, such as EACCES or ENOTDIR, raised while reading specification/loop-templates when from is set.
